hero.headline: Expert Psychiatric Care, Built Around You.
hero.subheadline: Board-certified psychiatrists delivering compassionate, evidence-based care via secure telehealth — for children, adults, and seniors alike.

philosophy.pull_quote: We believe the best outcome uses the least intervention necessary.

principles.title: Patient-Centered Care
principles.body: Every treatment plan begins with listening. Your goals, values, and lived experience guide every clinical decision we make.

principles.title: Medication Minimalism
principles.body: We prescribe thoughtfully and sparingly — exploring non-pharmacological approaches first and using medication only when it meaningfully improves your quality of life.

principles.title: Whole-Person Psychiatry
principles.body: Mental health doesn't exist in isolation. We consider your relationships, environment, and physical health as part of a complete picture.

services.heading: Psychiatric Care for Every Stage of Life
services.subheading: From childhood through the senior years, our board-certified providers offer specialized psychiatric care tailored to each life stage.

items.title: Child & Adolescent Psychiatry
items.description: Specialized care for children and teens navigating ADHD, anxiety, depression, and developmental challenges.

items.title: Adult Psychiatry
items.description: Comprehensive psychiatric evaluation and treatment for adults managing mood disorders, anxiety, trauma, and more.

items.title: Geriatric Psychiatry
items.description: Sensitive, expert care for older adults facing depression, cognitive changes, grief, and late-life transitions.

items.title: Medication Management
items.description: Careful, ongoing review of psychiatric medications — always with an eye toward simplicity and your long-term wellbeing.

credentials.heading: Care You Can Trust.
credentials.subheading: Our providers bring deep expertise and genuine compassion to every appointment.

pillars.label: Board-Certified Psychiatrists
pillars.detail: Every provider holds active board certification in psychiatry from the American Board of Psychiatry and Neurology.

pillars.label: Years Combined Experience
pillars.detail: Our clinical team brings deep, specialized experience across the full spectrum of psychiatric conditions and life stages.

pillars.label: Always
pillars.detail: We measure success not by prescription pads filled, but by the quality of life our patients reclaim.

cta.headline: Ready to Take the First Step?
cta.body: Reaching out is the hardest part. We make everything after that as simple and supportive as possible — from your first message to your first appointment.
